title: Understanding the Scatter Plot
text: Observe the distribution of the two types of wine in the scatter plot. Notice how the points for type $$0$$ and type $$1$$ are distributed along the hue and abv axes.

title: Analyzing the Hue Feature
text: Look at how the hue values are distributed for each wine type. Does one type tend to have higher or lower hue values compared to the other?

title: Impact of Hue on Classification
text: If one type of wine generally has higher hue values, what sign would you expect the weight for the hue feature to have in the logistic regression model?

title: Determining the Sign of the Hue Weight
text: Based on the scatter plot, if type $$1$$ wines generally have lower hue values than type $$0$$ wines, what sign should the weight for hue have?
